g.text: MEAN COST PER RESPONSE (USD) - FARTHER LEFT = CHEAPER
Axis starts at zero. Gemma 4 31B IT uses the campaign-configured zero rate; this is not a universal model price.
Common panel: 60 exercises, 17 models, 1,020 macro-averaged cells
